messages:
alex: Quick follow-up from yesterday's postmortem re: cache-eviction incident. We need a small, actionable runbook change set and owners. Can we list triage checkpoints + owners here?

maria: I can take the triage checklist edits. Plan: add explicit KV cache checks, eviction thresholds, and a quick rollback step. Target EOD Wed (2024-09-18). Assigning to @maria.

leo: I'll add the exact commands for diagnostics and cache dump. Proposed snippet:```
# check GPU mem + running tasks
kubectl -n redwood get pods -l app=runtime -o wide
# tail runtime logs
kubectl -n redwood logs -f runtime-0 -c runtime | grep -i eviction
# dump kv cache stats
curl -s http://localhost:9090/debug/kv | jq .
```

sarah: Adding escalation path: if runtime error rate > 2% for 5m AND p95 latency > 800ms -> page eng-oncall, go to priority channel, and failover to model-variant-b. Will add flow and playbook snippet. I'll own that. Due Fri (2024-09-20).

jun: Noted recurring pattern: these evictions correlate with sudden burst of long-context requests from a particular route (chat/batch). Suggest we add a routing rule to throttle or route to Dedicated pool when concurrent seq > 4. I'll draft policy. Owner: @jun. Due next Tues (2024-09-24).

alex: Great. Can we also add a quick local mitigation command for oncall? Something like:```
# temporarily reduce max_seq to 1024 on runtime config
curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' https://console.redwood.dev/api/v1/runtime/config -d '{"max_seq":1024}'
# trigger restart hook
curl -X POST https://deploy-bot.internal/restart?service=runtime
```

maria: Adding that under "Immediate mitigations". Also including a note: prefer config toggle over full restart when possible.

leo: For postmortem action tracking, propose these JIRA tickets:
- RW-INC-4533: runbook -> add KV checks + commands (owner: maria)
- RW-INC-4534: escalation flow + auto-notify (owner: sarah)
- RW-INC-4535: routing throttle policy (owner: jun)
- RW-INC-4536: add diagnostic dashboards for eviction patterns (owner: leo)
I'll create them after this thread.

ops-bot: Reminder: runbook edits require doc review and one infra + one SRE approval. Please add reviewers.

alex: Reviewers: @leo (infra) and @sarah (sre). Maria, ping them on your PR.

maria: Will do. Small ask: can someone drop a short sample alert rule for the p95+error combo?

leo: Draft alert rule:```
- alert: RuntimeEvictionBurst
  expr: (rate(runtime_errors_total[5m]) > 0.02) and (histogram_quantile(0.95, rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) > 0.8)
  for: 5m
  labels:
    severity: page
  annotations:
    summary: "Runtime eviction pattern: increased errors + latency"
    runbook: "https://docs.redwood.internal/runbooks/cache-eviction"
```

jun: Can we also add a scheduled recurring review? Every month for 3 months post-action completion to check for regressions. I'll add a calendar invite once JIRA tasks are created.

alex: Agreed. Action list summary in-thread so we don't lose it:
- maria: edit runbook (KV checks, immediate mitigations) — due 2024-09-18 — RW-INC-4533
- sarah: escalation + failover flow — due 2024-09-20 — RW-INC-4534
- jun: routing rule & throttle policy — due 2024-09-24 — RW-INC-4535
- leo: dashboards + alert rule + PR review — due 2024-09-20 — RW-INC-4536

alex: I'll own linking the postmortem to the runbook and closing the loop with customer-facing comms. Due 2024-09-25.

maria: PR will be up by tomorrow morning. tagging reviewers.

sarah: I'll prep the failover runbook card with steps and test checklist (canary test plan).

leo: For canary: plan to run synthetic traffic at 10% of baseline for 30m, validate no extra evictions, validate latency at p95 < 700ms. Add post-check commands in runbook.

jun: Noted. For the routing rule, will add a safe rollout: 5% -> 20% -> 100% with monitoring gates.

alex: Perfect. ops-bot, please remind owners 48h before due dates.

ops-bot: OK — I will post reminders 48 hours before each due date and once when the PR is merged.

maria: Thanks all. One more: adding a TODO to include a short reproduction snippet in the postmortem (request payload pattern) so ML/product know triggers.

alex: Good call. Add it to RW-INC-4533.

sarah: All set from my side. :thumbsup:

leo: LGTM.

jun: Thanks team.

alex: Closing the loop: I'll update the postmortem doc with owners and these links by EOD today. If anything changes, post here.

maria: PR: https://git.internal.redwood.com/r/runbooks/pulls/142 (draft)

leo: I'll review tomorrow.

ops-bot: Thread archived after 48h of inactivity.
